title: Law to stop repeat background checks for child care workers
summary: This bill would bar the Health Department from requiring another background check for a child care provider, employee or volunteer if one was already completed within the past 5 years. Exceptions apply if the person has been out of city child care work for more than 180 consecutive days or if a check is otherwise required by law. The change is meant to reduce delays caused by the department's background check backlog, which has previously taken up to a year to clear.
